subject.title: Feature: durable natural-language rule learning + explicit multi-mention reply semantics

question: Should OpenClaw define a first-class durable conversational rule-governance layer and a cross-channel all-explicitly-mentioned-bots reply contract, or keep this as narrower memory-plugin and channel-plugin work?
rationale: The requested behavior changes memory authority, persisted storage shape, workspace-file precedence, conflict resolution, and channel delivery semantics, so automation should not choose the product contract.

options.title: Keep as design tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open for maintainer-sponsored design that defines rule authority, storage, conflict precedence, and explicit multi-bot mention semantics before implementation.

options.title: Split narrower fixes
options.body: Treat Feishu self-mention and app-scoped identity failures through their existing focused trackers, and open a separate memory-governance design only if maintainers want that direction.

options.title: Require plugin/API proof first
options.body: Ask for a plugin or memory-plugin prototype and only add core API surface if current plugin seams cannot express the durable rule workflow safely.

recommendation.title: Keep as design tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for maintainer-sponsored design that defines rule authority, storage, conflict precedence, and explicit multi-bot mention semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest sampled cross-surface history across the current memory docs/promotion files and Feishu helper boundaries.
